$comment: The Website Specification MCP server — https://specification.website/mcp/
Stateless Streamable HTTP, no auth, read-only. Six tools + an audit_url prompt.
This is the canonical declaration. It is NOT loaded from here: Claude Code reads MCP
server definitions only from ~/.claude.json (untracked state) or a project's .mcp.json.
So this file is the copy-source — drop it in as a project's .mcp.json to switch the
server on there. The user-level settings.json pre-approves the name in
enabledMcpjsonServers, so it connects without a trust prompt wherever it appears.
Live in: ~/Projects/hogdot and ~/Projects/commongrounds. Off everywhere else, by
design — the vendored checklist in the website-spec skill is what makes an audit
